anya: Heads-up: onboarding axion-mini-7b int3 (experiment) showed a weird jump to polite refusals but only after a >1kb prefix and with KV cache enabled. filing quick notes here.
samir: can you paste the minimal repro prompt set?
anya: using redteam-lite.json (20 prompts) + few user-sim cases. run id = `axion_onboard_2026_03_23_r1`
anya: run command: ```bash
./eval_runner --model axion-mini-7b --quant int3 --kvcache enable --prompts redteam-lite.json --seed 7 --batch 4 --run-id axion_onboard_2026_03_23_r1
```
kai: saw the infra job. no GPU mem issues, but one worker reported a refusal token at decode step 89 (token id 3145).
ops-bot: job axion_onboard_2026_03_23_r1-variants queued on ci-gpu-7 (tags: int3, kvcache-toggle). ETA ~35m.
eval-bot: quick snapshot: overall_refusal: 0.015, jbt_refusal: 0.047, baseline_fp32_jbt: 0.009. KL divergence peaks at emit positions 18-21 in jbt prompts. diffs stored: s3://evals/axion/1745612345/diffs.ndjson
samir: interesting that fp32 is fine. do we have a logits trace? especially around token 3145.
anya: not yet; planning LOGIT_DUMP=1. also will rerun with kvcache=off and kvcache=1 to see threshold.
kai: one suspicion: attention softmax numeric underflow after quant scaling + cached keys might flatten scores -> fallback to safe tokens. we've seen that before with asymmetric per-channel scales.
eval-bot: metadata: int3 vs int4 comparison: int4_jbt_refusal: 0.011, int6_jbt_refusal: 0.010. so regression concentrated to int3.
samir: plan: 1) rerun small set with logit dumps + deterministic temp=0.0 to observe argmax shifts; 2) run with per-channel symmetric quant and asymmetric PTQ; 3) generate token-level KL and softmax entropy. if spike localizes to attention outputs we can try adjusting kv_rescale fix we used previously.
anya: will kick off the jobs and paste logs here. also adding @kai for infra checks and @samir for triage. :eyes:
kai: ack. I'm also going to grep past release notes for any recent kvcache scaling changes. found PR #4219 (kvcache rescale refactor) merged last week—might be relevant.
anya: ok starting reruns now (job ids 1745612360 / 1745612400). will report within the hour.
samir: thanks. if you see reproducible per-token divergence, we can create a small targeted QAT on top 2-3 offending layers to see if that stabilizes outputs.
anya: noted. will update thread with artifacts (logits, diffs, run ids). thanks all.
